question.knowledge_point: Finding the Reduced Row Echelon Form of a Singular 3x3 System With One Pivot
question.problem:
Consider the following system of linear equations:

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-x-2y+4z=-3 \\ 2x+4y-8z=6 \\ -3x-6y+12z=-9\end{aligned}
$$

Use the standard Gauss-Jordan method to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to reduced row echelon form.
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix for this system is

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}].
$$

Transforming $M$ to reduced row echelon form, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}M & ∼[\begin{aligned}-1 & -2 & 4 & -3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :=-{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 2 & 4 & -8 & 6 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}-2{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ -3 & -6 & 12 & -9\end{aligned}] & {R}_{3} & :={R}_{3}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & -4 & 3 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 0 & 0\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

judgment.reasoning: All ten current answers agree with their own captured worked solutions and with independent mathematical checks, confirming the corresponding earlier selections. No submitted grade is provided. q-74629: the RREF has nonzero rows (1,0,-21,4) and (0,1,6,-1), giving x=21z+4 and y=-6z-1 with z free. q-74626: the nonzero RREF rows are (1,0,-10,-1) and (0,1,4,1), giving x=10z-1 and y=1-4z. q-131647: negating the first row gives (1,2,-4,3); the other rows are multiples and reduce to zero. q-74612: the second and third rows are -10 and -4 times the first, leaving (1,-10,-5,10) and two zero rows. q-33655: the point requires t=1; the velocity is (4,2,4), whose norm is 6, yielding (2/3,1/3,2/3). q-33584: the point requires t=1; the velocity is (2,2,1), whose norm is 3, yielding (2/3,2/3,1/3). Its source introduction incorrectly repeats the basis vector j in the first component; this authored typo does not affect the subsequent calculation or final answer. q-32247: elimination gives RREF rows (1,0,10,-8) and (0,1,-6,6), hence x₁=-8-10x₃ and x₂=6+6x₃ with x₃ free. q-42019: adding twice the second row to the first gives (1,0,0,0), so x=0 and y=z-1. q-131719: all equations are multiples of x+4y=-1, leaving one free variable and infinitely many solutions; only II is true. q-74634: elimination produces the contradictory equation 0=9/2, so the system is inconsistent and only III is true.
